comment: 56yo male with new-onset type-2 diabetes (HbA1c 7.4% on two measurements; not on prior hypoglycemic therapy) within the past 9 months, accompanied by ~5 kg unintentional weight loss. New-onset T2DM age ≥50 with weight loss has ~1% absolute 3-year risk of occult pancreatic cancer — actionable surveillance signal per ACG 2022. Fires RF-CHRONIC-T2DM-CANCER-RISK-PREVENTION (relevant_diseases: PDAC, CRC, HCC, endometrial, breast). Engine routes to PreventionPlan: default = IND-CHRONIC-T2DM-CANCER-RISK-PREVENTION-SURVEILLANCE (consider EUS or MR-pancreas workup in high-risk new-onset T2DM + weight loss; glycemic control + weight management); alternative = IND-CHRONIC-T2DM-CANCER-RISK-PREVENTION-OBSERVATION (background cancer-screening adherence only).
